description: This Swift source file provides support for pairing alerts within a macOS application, including window management, alert configuration, push notification handling, and request approval/rejection logic.

classes.name: PairingAlertHostWindow
classes.description: A subclass of NSWindow configured to be a non-key, non-main floating window used as a host for pairing alert sheets.

classes.name: PairingAlertState
classes.description: A class holding the current state of pairing alerts, including the active alert, request ID, and associated window.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends and dismisses the current active alert if present, optionally referencing the parent window.

methods.name: requireAlertHostWindow
methods.description: Ensures there is a host window available for displaying alerts, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: configureDefaultPairingAlert
methods.description: Sets up a NSAlert with default styling and buttons for pairing operations.

methods.name: beginCenteredSheet
methods.description: Positions an alert as a centered sheet on the host window and begins its modal presentation.

methods.name: runPairingPushTask
methods.description: Handles background tasks for pairing push notifications, including refreshing connections and consuming push data.

methods.name: startPairingPushTask
methods.description: Starts a background task for pairing push notifications with control over stopping conditions.

methods.name: beginPairingAlert
methods.description: Creates and presents a pairing alert sheet centered on the host window with specified message texts.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert
methods.description: Displays a pairing alert with a specified request ID and message, managing the current active alert state.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert<Request>
methods.description: Generic method to present a pairing alert for a specific request type, handling responses asynchronously.

methods.name: clearActivePairingAlert
methods.description: Clears the current active alert and request ID, and hides the alert window.

methods.name: stopPairingPrompter
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompter, canceling tasks, dismissing alerts, and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: approveRequest
methods.description: Executes an approval action for a pairing request, logs success or failure.

methods.name: rejectRequest
methods.description: Executes a rejection action for a pairing request, logs success or failure.

calls: self.beginCenteredSheet(alert: alert, hostWindow: hostWindow, completionHandler: completion)
